title: HIGH: planar kernel drops one entire CURVED fill when two curved regions touch/overlap (curve-curve face extraction data loss; 1332 sibling)
description:
USER-IMPACTING DATA LOSS in the planar kernel curve/curve merge path. When two CURVED filled regions are merged and their boundaries TOUCH (tangent) or slightly OVERLAP, ONE ENTIRE region is dropped from the merged result — it leaks to the unbounded face and vanishes on planarShapeToShape read-back. Disjoint (non-touching) curved fills merge correctly; the failure begins exactly at first contact. This is the curve-aware analogue of the angled-line face-extraction failure in task 1332 (region leaks to unbounded), but in a DISTINCT code path: curve/curve intersection (intersect.ts intersectCurveCurve) + face extraction over curved half-edges, not the straight seg/seg path. Filed as a separate task because the fix locus differs.

REPRO (deterministic, pure kernel, no eraser; raster oracle = acceptance gate):
Two equal quadratic-bezier "circles" (4 quad segments, control points at the corner box (cx +/- r, cy +/- r)), r=30, centers on the same y. Vary horizontal center separation dx and merge RED + BLUE via buildArrangementFromShapes. Ground truth = z-order layered raster; merged = planarShapeToShape read-back rasterized. (raster-oracle.ts; SS=4.)

  centers (50,60) & (50+dx,60), r=30, 160x120 raster:
  dx=62 (gap 2, NOT touching) -> raster diff=0        OK (two faces, both colors)
  dx=60 (EXACTLY TANGENT at x=80) -> diff=3083; merged = RED only (6150 px),
        the entire BLUE circle is GONE.                BUG
  dx=58 (overlap 2)           -> diff=3056; merged = BLUE only (6104 px),
        the entire RED circle is GONE (12 px red left). BUG
  dx=55,40,30 (deeper overlap)-> diff ~2900-3000; one whole circle dropped.
  dx=70,50,45 (other depths)  -> diff<=4              OK
So like 1332 it is regime-dependent (specific overlap depths corrupt while
neighbors are clean), and the dropped color flips depending on orientation/depth.

NOTE on invariants: eulerCharacteristic is NOT a usable gate for curve cases —
a single LONE curved circle already reports euler=-2 with diff=0 (correct). The
RASTER ORACLE (merged read-back vs z-order ground truth, exact pixel counts) is
the reliable correctness signal; it cleanly separates OK (diff~0) from the
dropped-region BUG (diff~half the fill). totalBoundedFaceArea / face counts are
also unreliable here. Use raster diff.

MINIMAL standalone repro (the tangent case):
  circle(cx,cy,r) = start (cx,cy-r); quads via controls (cx+r,cy-r)->(cx+r,cy),
    (cx+r,cy+r)->(cx,cy+r), (cx-r,cy+r)->(cx-r,cy), (cx-r,cy-r)->(cx,cy-r); closed, filled.
  RED  = circle(50,60,30); BLUE = circle(110,60,30)   (tangent at x=80)
  buildArrangementFromShapes([RED, BLUE]) -> read-back drops the BLUE circle.
  EXPECTED: both circles present; raster diff vs z-order ground truth == 0
  (3080 red + 3080 blue px at 160x120).

ROOT CAUSE region (to localize during fix): arrangement.ts face extraction over
curved half-edges when two curve boundaries become coincident-tangent or cross
at near-grazing angles (curve/curve crossing vertices); analogous next/twin
linkage failure to 1332 but exercised through intersectCurveCurve. Same overall
defect CLASS as 1325/1326/1332 (near-degenerate face extraction), distinct
topology (curve-curve).

ACCEPTANCE: raster-oracle regression (two curved fills tangent/overlapping ->
merged read-back raster diff 0 vs z-order ground truth) across a sweep of
separations from gap to deep overlap; plus a real merge-drawing / editor check
that drawing two overlapping curved fills on one merge layer keeps both.

Found by autonomous QA face-extraction sweep at HEAD 57c0cf37b5f0a22b10f9bed32f08158539f366e7.
